payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate all scream times for Rick and Morty up to a hardcoded limit using set comprehensions, compute intersection, and print the minimum time or -1 if none.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates all possible times without pruning or problem-specific optimization. It does not employ bitmasks, branch-and-bound, graph search, or permutation generation. Backtracking is the most generic sequential trial method among the provided subtypes, albeit a loose fit.
